MONITORING MVP Role-change monitoring is included
The server subscribes to role creation, deletion, edits and position changes. Burst warnings are written to the Root app server log.

Role activity

Tracks documented role-change events and flags unusually frequent changes for review.

Actor verification

Not enabled yet. Root's currently documented event payloads do not establish a verified actor identity for these events.

Automatic enforcement

Disabled by design until actor attribution, owner exemptions and recovery behavior can be verified safely.
